premises.text: About one billion existing remote-control window and split air conditioners lack smart connectivity unlike Nest-style thermostats
premises.evidence_span: All I could find is smart thermostats like Nest. But I had this air conditioner in my home, and there are one billion of these kinds of air conditioners all around the world

premises.text: A retrofit Sensible pod can connect any remote-control AC to the internet for app control
premises.evidence_span: It works on any remote control air conditioner, window air conditioner, which is very popular in the big cities in the U.S., and the split types

premises.text: The system learns lifestyle and applies efficiency algorithms (efficient temperature, clogged filters, open windows, vacancy) to cut energy use substantially
premises.evidence_span: Sensible recognizes the efficient temperature. It can set it for you. It detects clogged filters. It detects open, if the window is open. And the air is leaking out. It detects that nobody is home

premises.text: Hardware is sold as a basic kit plus lower-priced add-on pods per additional AC
premises.evidence_span: The first kit, the basic kit for Sensible costs $160, and then for each additional air conditioner you have in your home or office, it's another $80

value.text: Make any existing AC smart with less energy cost and greener operation without manual control
value.evidence_span: We make any air conditioner smart

secondary_value.text: Reduce CO2 emissions alongside electricity-bill savings
secondary_value.evidence_span: we want the world to be greener to reduce co2 emissions and of course to affect your electricity bill
